meta.title: Pay yourself first (10%)
meta.blurb: Move a set share of every pay into savings before anything else, then spend the rest freely. The classic share is one tenth.
meta.after: George S. Clason, The Richest Man in Babylon (pamphlets from 1926, book 1930). Not affiliated with or endorsed by the estate.
meta.status: estimate. PROPOSED, NOT SHIPPED (FT-R-71): the catalogue ships only the Bucket method at launch.

checks.naming: A common phrase, not a brand. Title "Pay yourself first (10%)"; credit Clason in meta.after. UNVERIFIED: whether the 1926/1930 text is out of copyright in Australia (Clason died 1956, likely life plus 70).
